status: clean-source-candidate; parent visually checked; not user-approved; not an AI edit
note: 64 clean-source stills/backdrops for the folder covers whose AI edit was declined (policy). Sourced from public image search (TMDB, fanart, review sites, studio/distributor pages), preflighted, downloaded, visually verified clean (no trailer/promo text, no watermark), standardized to 1280x720 JPEG q92. Original trailer thumbnails remain at assets/covers/<folderId>.jpg. Candidates only — not user-approved.
limitations: All 64 are clean-source stills/backdrops, not AI edits and not clean-source-verified film frames in every case; some are key art/backdrops rather than literal film stills. Compare before-after before accepting.
It: Welcome to Derry still is from It Chapter Two (same Pennywise universe) — no text-free Welcome to Derry backdrop was found; it is a stand-in, not a true Derry still.
Nightmare on Elm Street source was 600x375, so the 1280x720 output is a ~2.1x upscale and will look softer than the rest.
Star Trek: Picard still features Riker (S3E8), not Picard; Star Trek: Discovery still has Burnham small/distant; Parasyte: The Grey still is dark with no lead character visible.
Star Trek: TOS source was 828x621 (4:3) and Rick & Morty source 900x600, so mild upscale after the 16:9 crop; acceptable but the softest live-action files.

Sinners still is key-art style (posed against a giant orange sun) rather than a literal film frame; Office Space has small in-scene prop text on Milton's badge; Ash vs The Evil Dead still reads as Evil Dead II-era rather than specifically the TV series.

Batman Noir source had baked-in letterbox bars, trimmed before the standard 16:9 crop; Wipeout has in-scene set banners/wordmark; Ash vs Evil Dead has in-scene 'SMASH'/'M' set painting; Twisted Metal and X-Men are clean key art/backdrops rather than literal film frames.
Godzilla (2014) and Harry Potter stills are clean key-art backdrops rather than pure film stills.
No repository, Drive, sharing or source evidence overwritten. Originals preserved.
